column1: # 07-camera traversal (mantle) camera pitch offset. Two tables per class, 21 points each at u = 0, 0.05, ..., 1.
# anim_<class>: animation fraction at traversal TIME fraction u (u = time since mantle start / mantle duration).
# delta_<class>: pitch offset [deg, + = view down] at ANIMATION fraction. Camera pitch offset(t) = delta(anim(u)) * smoothstep(t / 0.15 s); linear between points.

# StandH120 blends toward StandH120Yaw45 by w = clamp(|view-to-wall yaw| / 45 deg) (standing h120 only).
